preconditions: Select decision-only, execution or fusion mode; identify actual input data, recipients and project scope.
Use the registry and provider configuration authorized for this task; key availability is not authorization or endpoint health.
Separate estimated tiers, costs and confidence from measured usage and independently verified task results.

expected_effects.effect: route/decide, explain and providers read routing state and return a proposal without an inference call.
expected_effects.scope: Backend registry, environment-key availability, local thresholds/policy, learned weights/calibration and CLI output.
expected_effects.basis: decide reads the registry and consults heuristics and optional belts; providers resolves catalog entries by key presence. explain includes a prompt excerpt and recomputes the decision.
expected_effects.impact: Can expose prompt excerpts or host/model metadata; a selected tier can influence a later paid request. Explicit FREE is retained but can still select local inference.
expected_effects.verification: Use controlled registry/provider fixtures; assert no inference calls and distinguish the selected route from actual execution.

expected_effects.effect: run transmits prompt/system data to the selected kind of model on a cache miss.
expected_effects.scope: Local or cloud inference endpoints, consumed compute and returned text/usage.
expected_effects.basis: LocalLLMClient.chat or _cloud_chat performs the request. No usable route returns an error; a local failure returns an error without automatic cloud fallback, while cloud exceptions propagate.
expected_effects.impact: May disclose sensitive context, incur cost and return an incorrect answer. CLI run exits 1 for returned errors; successful text remains unverified.
expected_effects.verification: Capture fixture request arguments, returned errors and exit codes; obtain independent target-task evidence and actual provider usage for a real run.

expected_effects.effect: run consults and writes the shared response cache and its statistics, including on a cache hit.
expected_effects.scope: ResponseCache files under its configured directory, initially .botte-cache relative to import-time working directory; plaintext prompts and answers.
expected_effects.basis: Exact prompt SHA-256, resolved project, selected endpoint/transport, model, system, task type, mode and max_tokens participate in reuse. Lookup disables semantic fallback; a hit still updates cache/statistics. An unresolved scope skips caching.
expected_effects.impact: Old unscoped entries miss; a miss can incur fresh inference. Shared storage, credentials, changing model weights and project contents are not isolated or automatically invalidated.
expected_effects.verification: Replay identical prompts and variants in temporary caches; compare endpoint/project/whitespace cases, retained entries and actual backend-call counts.

expected_effects.effect: run attempts route, learning-observation, control-loop and quality-outcome writes and updates in-memory cloud spending counters.
expected_effects.scope: Project events, private active-learning state, control-loop history, project_root quality ledger and router-instance budget.
expected_effects.basis: Logging is best-effort. Outcomes mark returned/cache text PARTIAL, no route ABSTAINED and backend errors FAIL. execution_id deduplicates the outcome ledger only; cloud accounting uses reported total tokens and static tier rates.
expected_effects.impact: Telemetry can contain task text or private model/host context outside the hashed outcome fields. Retries can still duplicate inference, telemetry and costs; failures can leave partial evidence.
expected_effects.verification: Compare temporary ledgers and call counts across success, cache hit, failure and replay; do not infer verified labels or actual billing from these records.

expected_effects.effect: fusion may transmit one task to several backends, including a local draft in a cloud refinement request.
expected_effects.scope: All selected inference recipients, intermediate answers, ballots, aggregate compute and provider-side records.
expected_effects.basis: cascade can escalate by a phrase/length heuristic; draft_refine forwards question plus draft; vote loops over all available cloud catalog candidates. Direct fusion calls bypass AutoRouter budget accounting and caching.
expected_effects.impact: Costs and disclosures multiply. Normalized/truncated answer agreement and fluent text can conceal common errors; no aggregate budget cap is enforced.
expected_effects.verification: Use fixture call captures for draft/refine and each ballot; independently evaluate final answers and real aggregate usage before target deployment.

downstream_effects.effect: Cached or generated answers and routing telemetry may shape later agent actions and routing policy.
downstream_effects.scope: Consumers of answers, control-loop history and explicit feedback/learning workflows.
downstream_effects.basis: run returns text to callers and records telemetry; explicit verified corrections can later become learning inputs.
downstream_effects.impact: Stale context or unverified output can propagate into decisions or mislabeled training data.
downstream_effects.verification: Trace evidence from the actual source and task; require independent verification before labeling or accepting reuse.

downstream_effects.effect: A timeout or cache miss after a context change can cause repeated paid work when retried.
downstream_effects.scope: Remote requests, retained cache/outcomes and cumulative spending across instances.
downstream_effects.basis: There is no provider idempotency key or cancellation handshake, and outcome deduplication is separate from execution.
downstream_effects.impact: Remote work may finish after the caller fails; a new instance resets budget counters without reconciling earlier spend.
downstream_effects.verification: Check provider-side completion where available, inspect partial artifacts and reconcile actual usage before repeating an uncertain request.

reversibility.strategy: Reconcile requests and retained artifacts; restore authorized local snapshots only after checking later writers. Reverting local files cannot undo inference or disclosure.
residual_effects: Sent prompts/drafts, provider logs and consumed compute cannot be recalled by this module.
Cache and telemetry writes span separate resources without a transaction or automatic rollback.

retry.check_before_retry: Distinguish a decision-only read from inference, fusion, cache access and telemetry. Check existing results and incomplete remote requests; execution_id is not execution idempotency.
retry.stop_condition: Resolve unknown completion, unsuitable recipients, repeated endpoint errors or uncertain available budget before issuing another costly or sensitive request.

required_scope: Existing task authority must cover prompt/system/draft disclosure to each actual recipient, local state writes and any paid inference. A key, tier, cache entry or declaration grants no additional authority.

analysis.summary: Documented AutoRouter, CLI and fusion entry points combine advisory decisions with inference, cache reuse and best-effort telemetry. Fixture checks demonstrate specific requests, errors and reuse boundaries, not model quality or production savings.
uncertainties: Budget estimates omit some real prompt/output details; there is no calendar reset, reservation or hard end-to-end cost/latency guarantee.
LocalLLMClient selects its backend again: the selected endpoint in the cache context is not an execution lock. Credentials and model weights can change behind the same endpoint.
Imported response_cache, llm_backends, tiered_router, events, trajectory, control_loop and botte_nn implementations/state are outside these skill-local source bindings.
Router/fusion operations lack a complete observation adapter; dependency observations cannot attest remote effects or success.
Other entry points such as composite, speculative, dry_cloud, session_budget and diagnostic scripts require their own operation review.

reuse.target: Evaluate local/cloud routing and exact response reuse for another scoped agent workflow.
reuse.rationale: Decisions, outcomes and injectable clients/caches allow controlled comparison before real inference.
adaptations: Define permitted recipients, target-specific freshness rules and isolated cache storage where required.
Track actual aggregate usage across instances/fusion and verify outputs independently before learning from them.
reuse.validation: Replay representative tasks with changed prompts, projects, endpoints and failures; then compare authorized target-model quality, actual usage and retained data.
